limitation: Shortcut screen, not proof of semantic difficulty or source fidelity.

localization.multiplicity: Bonferroni over two fixed localization rules
localization.null: Exact within-family permutation of the four reference blocks; sibling pairs move together. Noncandidate tail abstains.
localization.rule: tail producer plus unique immediately following back-reference consumer

policy: Within-family label permutations; refit all probes and compare best-of-k to each permuted best-of-k. Pass p >= 0.05; no seed or nonce search.
prose_scope: Exact shared argument text; three prose-only probes included in every best-of-k null refit. Original node probes cover the additional VE node block.
